findings.text: follow-on: removing data-attempts emission from reckon/_plan_html.py and forcing attempts=0 on every write leaves six cases red at head (legacy-roundtrip-follow-on.log: 6 failed, 29 passed in 2.57s) because this file still asserts the stored attribute round-trips through read_state; the reviewed manifest declares it out of its write grant and defers a separate test update, so it is a real regression the delta introduces and does not repair.

follow-on: the reviewed run is live at review time (live pointer phase=working on this host) while its manifest read complete and has since been rewritten to in-progress; HEAD advanced fd9cdbf9 -> 1a3c4ef9 mid-review and the worktree carries uncommitted edits, and 1a3c4ef9 reverts this delta's dirty-plan admission (test_dispatch_refuses_a_dirty_plan), so fd9cdbf9 is already superseded and no reader should treat it as the run's landed state.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit -- 275d61fc pins the derived-history tests, d2b52e54 derives attempts across mcp_views/roadmap/store, 4e710f2c covers verifier and superseded outcomes, d926d6e1 admits dispatch beside a dirty plan, fd9cdbf9 stops writing legacy data-attempts.
item_verdicts.done_when: the delta's own measure -- the seven-file gate passes 50/50 at fd9cdbf9 (reviewed run's after-suite, corroborated by my independent run: 50 passed in 196.33s, EXIT=0) and the same seven fail 5 at base da7ff47cd (resume-no-change, unpassed-run-superseded, review-exclusion, dirty-plan handling, write-drops-attribute).
item_verdicts.goal: the delta moves SS4 from a stored tool-written counter to a value derived from crew run history (reckon/mcp_views.py:1472 section_attempts_by_plan), read back onto the section (reckon/_store.py:1519 in read_plan) and into the roadmap ready set (reckon/roadmap.py:2213 in _build_roadmap), so dispatch no longer writes the plan at all; it matches SS4's visible count and outcome intent while reinterpreting "records the outcome on the section" as a derived view rather than a stored field.
item_verdicts.manifest: read at orientation -- status complete, commits ending fd9cdbf9, baseline_suite revision da7ff47cd (5 failed) and after_suite revision fd9cdbf9 (0 failed), negative_control log whose last line reads EXIT=1; but the reviewed run is live and its manifest has since been rewritten to status in-progress, so the complete record I read is no longer current.
item_verdicts.write_paths: git diff --name-only da7ff47cd..fd9cdbf9 returns exactly the seven files this node names -- reckon/_plan_html.py, reckon/_store.py, reckon/crew/dispatch.py, reckon/crew/promotion.py, reckon/mcp_views.py, reckon/roadmap.py, tests/test_section_attempts_are_tool_owned.py -- and no others; 324 insertions and 464 deletions.

justifications.durability: tests/test_section_attempts_are_tool_owned.py:157-290 asserts resume-no-change, promoted/failed/superseded outcomes, review exclusion, live in-flight counting and that a plan write drops the non-authoritative data-attempts; but the reviewed revision is already superseded (1a3c4ef9 reverted the dirty-plan admission of d926d6e1/fd9cdbf9) and six round-trip tests are left red out of scope.
justifications.evidence: the reviewed run's after-suite (fd9cdbf9, 50 passed EXIT=0) and baseline (da7ff47cd, 5 failed EXIT=1) match the manifest's baseline_suite/after_suite failure_ids, and my independent seven-file run also reported 50 passed EXIT=0; the run went live mid-review, so the working tree no longer equals the pinned revision.
justifications.fit: five commits carry conventional subjects with bodies, no AI trailer, and the added symbols name the mechanism (section_attempts_by_plan, _visible_plan_commit_with_working_edit) with no plan or sprint identifier.
justifications.goal_fidelity: dispatch no longer writes the plan (reckon/crew/dispatch.py:6197 removal of _record_dispatch_section_launch); attempts and outcomes derive from run history (reckon/mcp_views.py:1472) and surface in read_plan (reckon/_store.py:1519) and the roadmap ready set (reckon/roadmap.py:2213), satisfying SS4's visible count and outcome intent via derivation.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --name-only da7ff47cd..fd9cdbf9 is exactly the seven node-declared files, with the deletions concentrated in the removed stored-counter helpers (_store record_section_* and dispatch _record_dispatch_section_launch) and no file outside scope touched.
